headline.text: L1 Sollich 2 nut lot held after crew found *eggs and insect material* during hand-sort — 0.5% defect rate on first pallet, second pallet complete, inspection ongoing.

summary: One active ingredient hold at L1 (nut contamination). L1 Sollich 4 tunnel cover fell off during cleaning — corner piece previously glued, now taped and being re-adhered. L3 ML1 Z-conveyor failed initial ATP, passed after re-sanitization. All other cleaning verifications passed across three plants.

holds.title: Nut lot held for hand-sort after foreign material found
holds.summary: Incoming nut lot showing eggs and fuzzy material (possible insect larvae) — crew hand-sorting, first pallet 0.5% defect rate, second pallet completed by 22:37, inspection continuing.
holds.status: Open — second pallet sorted, additional pallets queued for inspection.

holds.title: Crème de menthe barrel held by first shift
holds.summary: One barrel of crème de menthe on ML4 line flagged on hold by first shift — QA identified at 20:39, recommended appropriate action.
holds.status: Open — awaiting disposition, flagged for supervisor review.

food_safety.title: Tunnel cover corner fell off during Sollich 4 cleaning
food_safety.summary: Cooling tunnel cover corner piece detached when first cover lifted — had been glued previously, now taped and sent to maintenance for adhesive repair (12-hour cure time required).
food_safety.status: Resolved — cover removed from production area, adhesive applied, curing in maintenance shop until 08:43 Monday.

food_safety.title: Second washer found on Sollich 3 belt during assembly check
food_safety.summary: Metal washer located on side of belt (not in product path) — maintenance confirmed it matches type used in recent assembly, both washers now accounted for.
food_safety.status: Resolved — both washers accounted for, found outside product contact zone.

sanitation.title: ML1 Z-conveyor failed initial ATP, passed after re-clean
sanitation.summary: Z-conveyor unwrapped and swabbed at 20:32 — initial ATP failed, re-sanitized and passed second ATP at 21:04.
sanitation.status: Resolved — passed second ATP after sanitization, cleared for production.

sanitation.title: ML1 tank changeover required multiple flush cycles for residue
sanitation.summary: Chocolate residue visible in Marcos tank after initial flush — crew concern raised about draining through bottom vs pipe system, multiple oil-fill-drain cycles executed until acceptable at 08:57.
sanitation.status: Resolved — agitator repositioned, additional flushing completed, tank filled with zero-sugar chocolate and set to night mode.

opportunities.title: Consider permanent tunnel cover repair or replacement — based on Sollich 4 corner piece falling off after repeated glue repairs.
Consider adding tank drain method to ML1 changeover checklist — based on shift confusion over bottom drain vs pipe-flush protocol and residue remaining after initial flush.
